title: Function coefficients satisfy sample equations
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be a Boolean function whose algebraic normal form has degree at most $\ell$, and choose any finite list $x_1,\ldots,x_m\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Assign to each monomial indexed by a set $S$ with $|S|\le\ell$ the algebraic normal form coefficient of $f$ at $S$. This assignment satisfies every sample equation: at each $x_i$, the sum over such $S$ of that assigned coefficient times $\prod_{q\in S}(x_i)_q$ equals $f(x_i)$ in $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the n-dimensional Boolean cube over F₂
Its algebraic degree is at most ℓ
A finite list of m sample inputs
